root_cause: Relationship enrichment was event- and trigger-centric, so the full connection graph did not have a guaranteed daily refresh contract even when new LinkedIn and external evidence had already been ingested.
decision: Add one set-based daily full-graph enrichment projection that reuses all canonical evidence stores and the existing commercial scheduler. Detailed evidence remains in canonical source stores; the daily state is a rollup and provenance pointer.
prevention: Every canonical connection must receive a daily enrichment pass.
All already-ingested LinkedIn and external evidence must be projected onto matching connections each cycle.
Do not duplicate source evidence into a parallel CRM; retain provenance pointers to canonical stores.
Deep external discovery remains prioritized and bounded; daily full-graph refresh must not imply one paid search per connection.
No sensitive personal inference or platform-bypass.
evidence: Controlled production refresh enriched 23,295 of 23,295 canonical connections with zero remaining and completion ratio 1.0.
Existing scheduler powerhouse-commercial-learning-v1 remains the single owner through powerhouse_trigger_based_mkb_acquisition_cycle_v1(date).
Detailed LinkedIn and external evidence remains in canonical source stores and is referenced through the daily enrichment rollup.
